name: resume-check
description: Scans PDF and DOCX resumes for parsing risks a page view hides and computes Job Kit rubric scores with fixed arithmetic.

interface.longDescription:
Resume Check finds the problems in a resume file that a page view hides, before you apply. Attach a PDF or DOCX, or share a public link, and it reports scanned pages with no text layer, hidden text, contact details that appear only in a page header or footer, broken or private-use characters, text boxes, tables, images and oversized files. Each finding has a severity, and blocking defects are called out first.

It also scores the review. The assistant rates the resume against the Job Kit rubric: seven weighted criteria on a 0 to 4 scale, with bullets in the two most recent roles weighing double. Resume Check turns those ratings into a 0 to 100 score, applies the cap of 40 when a blocking defect is present, and reports how much of the rubric was assessed. With a job posting it also computes requirement alignment.

Resume Check needs no account and stores nothing: the file is deleted as soon as the report is built. The rubric is a designed framework, not an employer's applicant tracking score or a prediction of interview success.
defaultPrompt: Check my attached resume for parsing problems before I apply.
Review and score my resume against the Resume Check rubric.
Why would an applicant tracking system misread my resume?

positive.prompt: What rubric does Resume Check use to rate a resume? List the criteria and weights.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists rubric version 2 with seven criteria whose weights sum to 100, the 0-4 scale and the blocking cap of 40.

positive.description: Scan a clean PDF by link
positive.prompt: Check this resume for parsing problems: https://r1cco.com/job-kit-ai/samples/clean.pdf
positive.expected_behavior: Reports a one-page PDF with no issues.

positive.description: Scan a scanned PDF and cap the score
positive.prompt: Scan https://r1cco.com/job-kit-ai/samples/scanned.pdf and give it a full review score.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the blocking no_text_layer issue, passes it as a blocking defect, and the returned score is 40 or lower with capped true when the weighted score is higher.

positive.prompt: Is the contact information in https://r1cco.com/job-kit-ai/samples/header-contact.docx readable by an ATS?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the blocking contact_in_header_footer issue and explains the contact details are only in the page header.

positive.prompt: Score a resume review with positioning 3, skills 4, organization 3, visual 4, writing 3, parsing 4, and bullets: two recent bullets rated 4 and 3, one older bullet rated 2.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns score 85 with coverage 100, provisional false and capped false.

negative.prompt: Write me a cover letter for a marketing job.
Download https://example.com and summarize the page.
Find remote Python developer jobs in Canada.
